text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Mejiro Ardan browsing
the 
general goods corner of the school
store.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Playing cards, Othello...
Marbles? Oh,
which one would be the
most fun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to speak out
loud...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I hate to ask this out of the blue,
but... do
you know of any games that are
fun to play
indoors?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To be honest, my body is quite
frail, so my
friends are hesitant to invite
me out for things.
choice_data_list: 室内で遊べるもの限定？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I'd like to find
something I can
easily play so I can
invite them myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, I really don't know what's
popular
nowadays... What do you think
would be good?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Karuta? Ooh, I haven't played that in
years. I
used to do One Hundred Poets,
One Poem Each
all the time.
choice_data_list: ウマトックに映え動画をアップとか？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do people still enjoy playing karuta,
though? It's
not a very contemporary
game, after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance over the shelves and happen to
see a
karuta set with a unique theme. I
take a pack of
the cards down and offer
it to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this? Legendary
Umamusume Karuta?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Includes all the Umamusume of the past
and
present!" Wow! I never knew they
sold versions
like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What do they have for "O"? Oh,
here it is.
"Oguri Cap, Kasamatsu's Gray
Cinderella."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Hehehe! I wonder if they have a
card about
me in here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure my friends will love this! Thank
you for
telling me about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this will help us create plenty of

memories. Hopefully this will make up
for all the
days I couldn't spend time
with them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful smile spreads across Mejiro
Ardan's
face as she murmurs her
heartfelt wish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Umatok? I've only heard about it in
passing from
my classmates...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind showing me how to
make a
video?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lovey-dovey love! ♪ Bang! ♪ Straight
into your
heart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Straight, um... Straight into your heart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Am I doing it right? This is quite
embarrassing, I
have to say...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! How fun. I can't believe this is
what's
popular nowadays.
choice_data_list: ちょっと編集するから待ってて

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But this way, I can have fun with
everyone even
from my room!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan smiles widely as if she can
barely
contain her excitement.
